title: Brief step output (v1)
description: Output of pipeline step 1 (spec 3.6). The brief is the confirmed intent of the course, not part of the blueprint, so it has no counterpart in blueprint.v1.json and defines its own shapes.

target.description: Whether the job builds a new course or extends an existing one.

language.description: Language of the course, defaulting to Romanian upstream of this schema.
